attestations.text: Fang Kuang-chên 方光琛 (T. 獻廷, H. 雲鶴, d. 1681) a native of Shê-hsien, Anhwei, who had served as a Grand Secretary in the rebellious Wu San-kuei regime. Emperor Shêng-tsu, however, mitigated the harsh verdict to some extent, with the result that only Tai Ming-shih was executed.
